// Trimmed copy of enum blocks from the pinned upstream
// wowsims/forever@0cfb1a027cd4f73ae42e1db9b78d10ed6532a1f4 proto/common.proto (MIT).
// Used only as parser test data.
syntax = "proto3";
package proto;

enum Stat {
	// Primary attributes ("main stat")
	StatStrength = 0;
	StatAgility = 1;
	StatStamina = 2;
	StatIntellect = 3;

	// Spell Power and Spell Power derivatives
	StatHealingPower = 4;
	StatSpellDamage = 5;
	StatArcaneDamage = 6;
	StatFireDamage = 7;
	StatFrostDamage = 8;
	StatHolyDamage = 9;
	StatNatureDamage = 10;
	StatShadowDamage = 11;

	// Caster Secondaries
	// The game files' name for spell penetration: "Rune of Perfection" states
	// "Spell Piercing increased".
	StatSpellPiercing = 12;
	StatSpirit = 13;

	// Physical Secondaries
	StatAttackPower = 14;
	StatRangedAttackPower = 15;
	StatFeralAttackPower = 16;

	// Shared Secondaries: one rating each converts into the melee, ranged
	// and spell percentages alike.
	StatHitRating = 17;
	StatCritRating = 18;
	StatHasteRating = 19;

	// Physical Secondaries
	StatArmorPenetration = 20;
	StatExpertiseRating = 21;

	// Tank Secondaries
	StatDefenseRating = 22;
	StatBlockRating = 23;
	StatBlockValue = 24;
	StatDodgeRating = 25;
	StatParryRating = 26;
	StatArmor = 27;
	StatBonusArmor = 28;

	// Composite stats that are built up from the above gear stats + buffs.
	// These still belong in the Stat enum because they can be present on
	// some enchants and because the base values need to be stored for NPCs.
	StatHealth = 29;
	StatMana = 30;
	StatMP5 = 31;

	// Resistances
	StatArcaneResistance = 32;
	StatFireResistance = 33;
	StatFrostResistance = 34;
	StatNatureResistance = 35;
	StatShadowResistance = 36;

	StatPhysicalDamage = 37;

	// Armor that neither the percent armor modifiers nor the scaling of armor
	// from items touch, which A_MOD_ARMOR_NO_MODS states. It adds to Armor.
	StatArmorNoMods = 38;

	// DO NOT add new stats here without discussing it first; new stats come
	// with a performance penalty.

	// Checklist for making breaking changes to the Stat enum (deleting
	// stats, re-ordering stats, changing the interpretation of stat values,
	// etc.):
	// (1) Make the desired change in the enum above.
	// (2) Mirror the change in sim/core/stats/stats.go .
	// (3) Update any required code in sim/core for proper sim behavior.
	// (4) If the total number of stats changed, then change the size of the
	//     Stats array type defined in tools/database/wowhead_tooltips.go .
	// (5) Run "make items" so that the sim database reflects the stats
	//     change. At this point, you should see no changes in DPS results
	//     when running "make test", if the only changes made were indexing
	//     or bookkeeping adjustments. However, saved browser settings and
	//     old sim links will be broken on the UI side.
	// (6) Increment the current_version_number option in the ProtoVersion
	//     message at the top of this file.
}

enum PseudoStat {
	PseudoStatMainHandDps = 0;
	PseudoStatOffHandDps = 1;
	PseudoStatRangedDps = 2;
	PseudoStatBlockValueMultiplier = 3;
	PseudoStatDodgePercent = 4;
	PseudoStatParryPercent = 5;

	// Spell School Hit
	PseudoStatSchoolHitPercentArcane = 6;
	PseudoStatSchoolHitPercentFire = 7;
	PseudoStatSchoolHitPercentFrost = 8;
	PseudoStatSchoolHitPercentHoly = 9;
	PseudoStatSchoolHitPercentNature = 10;
	PseudoStatSchoolHitPercentShadow = 11;

	PseudoStatMeleeHitPercent = 12;
	PseudoStatSpellHitPercent = 13;
	PseudoStatMeleeCritPercent = 14;
	PseudoStatSpellCritPercent = 15;
	PseudoStatBlockPercent = 16;

	PseudoStatMeleeSpeedMultiplier = 17;
	PseudoStatRangedSpeedMultiplier = 18;
	PseudoStatCastSpeedMultiplier = 19;
	PseudoStatMeleeHastePercent = 20;
	PseudoStatRangedHastePercent = 21;
	PseudoStatSpellHastePercent = 22;
	PseudoStatBlockValuePerStrength = 23;

	PseudoStatRangedHitPercent = 24;
	PseudoStatRangedCritPercent = 25;

	PseudoStatReducedCritTakenPercent = 26;

	// Dodge/parry reduction in percent. Forever's sources are mostly flat percentages
	// (talents, the Hyjal flask); ExpertiseRating covers the few rating-denominated ones
	// (the tier 1 4P bonuses) and converts into this at 10 rating per percent.
	PseudoStatExpertisePercent = 27;

	// Character sheet values per attack; the sim never reads them back.
	PseudoStatOffHandHitPercent = 28;
	PseudoStatOffHandCritPercent = 29;
	PseudoStatMainHandHitRating = 30;
	PseudoStatMainHandCritRating = 31;
	PseudoStatOffHandHitRating = 32;
	PseudoStatOffHandCritRating = 33;
	PseudoStatRangedHitRating = 34;
	PseudoStatRangedCritRating = 35;
	PseudoStatMeleeCritSuppressionPercent = 36;
	PseudoStatRangedCritSuppressionPercent = 37;
	// The main-hand auto attack's table against the current target, 0 before the attack tables exist.
	PseudoStatMainHandMissPercent = 38; // The miss hit has to cover.
	PseudoStatMainHandDodgePercent = 39;
	PseudoStatMainHandParryPercent = 40; // The target's parry against attacks from in front, not the character's own.
	PseudoStatMainHandGlancePercent = 41;
}

enum EnchantProcKind {
	EnchantProcKindNone = 0;
	EnchantProcKindCombat = 1; // Any proc that is not survival only: damage, a stat buff, a debuff, a resource restore.
	EnchantProcKindSurvival = 2; // Every effect of the proc absorbs, heals or adds armor.
}
